Short Chop.info: Equip your Fix with the Short Chop, a medium suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Increases ranges, deadly quiet. Do not use to break boards. 30 Stud detection radius.

FT300 Suppressor.info: An integral suppressor for the FT300 competition rifle. Preserve damage, range and increases the torso multiplier in exchange for poorer velocity. Lower suppression radius.

Suppressor (DT11).info: Integral Suppressor for your competition shotgun. Preserves range and damage and the weight reduces felt weapon recoil. With small velocity, spread and weight penalties.

Sionics Suppressor.info:
No detection radius.

A unique suppressor designed for the MAC-10, famous for being so quiet that the action can be heard cycling. A mixture of the long barrel and heavy suppressor. Great for close range combat, but can be decently useful at long range too.

PBS-4 Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A medium suppressor that reduces rotational recoil while also mildly reducing camera body recoil and increasing range performance slightly with average sound masking.
Reduces mobility and handling.

Integral U416.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the U-527/22.

Improves performance at close range at the cost of ranged performance and velocity. Excellent masking.

SLX Suppressor.info:
20 stud detection radius.

The new standard military suppressor for the M7!
Slightly increases damage ranges, bullet speed and lowers muzzle flip at the cost of a bit more vertical camera recoil and slightly slower handling!

Vikhr Suppressor.info:
A Zarovian suppressor akin to the one used on the AS VAL.
This suppressor behaves as a longer barrel giving your gun less recoil and preserving damage, slightly increased ranges with slower mobility, handling and reload speed as a tradeoff.

SD Barrel.info: Equip your Mini Fix with an integrally suppressed barrel. Reduces performance at range. 0 Stud detection radius.

Integrated BREN3.info:
An integral suppressor designed for the VZ.808 rifle. Increases close-range damage while reducing damage at range.
25 studs detection range.

Suppressor..?.info:
Wait, what are you doing? Stop, this literally doesn't give you any benefit. Why are you like this?
(It does nothing but pitch up your fire sound. Do not buy).

Suppressor (RAILGUN).info:
50% muzzle velocity loss.
50 stud detection radius.

How on earth do you suppress this thing?

Trash Panda.info: Equip your Mini Fix with the Trash Panda, a medium suppressor. Reduces performance at range. Pairs well with 5.56x45mm. 30 Stud detection radius. Do not bring near dumpsters.

LMX Suppressor.info:
25 stud detection radius.

An unique suppressor designed for the X46A2!
Improves mid-range performance at the cost of some handling.

Suppressor.info:
70 stud detection radius.

A general purpose balanced duty suppressor.
Provides decent sound masking, well-rounded recoil reductions but a trade-off in handling speed and mobility while aiming.

R2 Suppressor.info:
100 stud detection radius.

A light suppressor that compromises on sound masking range with a minor reduction to recoil and minimal impact to handling.

Q Pork Chop.info:
0 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor designed for large .30-cal magnum calibers. Deadly quiet. Improves damage ranges. Do not eat.

SHAK-12 Heavy Suppressor.info: A heavyweight suppressor for the ShAK-12 which provides excellent masking & sound suppression as well as improved recoil at the cost of handling.

Maxim Silencer.info:
The first successful suppressor design.
An old suppressor from 1909 that saw limited use on the M1903 Springfield. Being one of the first suppressors, it is not as effective as modern ones available to you, but does have its own range of benefits.

Muffler (Alt).info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and in this case, will not affect firerate.

ARS Suppressor.info:
30 stud detection radius.

A heavy suppressor that has the greatest masking performance improvements.
It also reduces overall recoil significantly due to its weight while also lowering mobility and handling the most.

HB Trash Panda.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Lengthened barrel with a trash panda suppressor at the end.
Improves range, bullet speed and penetration while suppressing your gun at the cost of worse movement and handling.
Does not reduce recoil and weapon sway due to a lack of extended handguard.

HB SD Suppressor.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Lengthened barrel & handguard with a dedicated SD suppressor.
Improves range, bullet speed and penetration while suppressing your gun at the cost of worse movement and handling.
The lengthened handguard provides lower recoil, hipfire spread and weapon sway but heavier weight.

SHAK-12 Light Suppressor.info: A lightweight suppressor designed for the ShAK-12. Reduces sound signature and slightly reduces gun performance. Poor masking range.

BOOMBOX SD Suppressor.info:
0 stud detection radius.

Uses a cut-off handguard with an integral suppressor.
Excellent radar & sound masking while mildly lowering weapon sway and recoil but slightly reduces handling speeds.
No effects on bullet speed, mobility or damage ranges!

Muffler.info:
10% muzzle velocity lost.
No sound masking 
Cheap homemade 'suppressor' that reduces the volume of shots fired / recoil of a gun, but will still set off radars and reduce RPM by 10%.

Integral Suppressor (GOLDHAWK).info:
An integral suppressor designed for the .300 BLK SCAR SC and intended for police usage.
Increases bullet speed, penetration and damage range at the cost of hipfire spread, walk speed and handling!

AEK-919K PMS Suppressor.info:
50 stud detection radius.

A special suppressor for the AEK-919K that increases your headshot damage while mildly reducing vertical recoil and increasing range.
Reduces damage over range and mildly reduces mobility and handling.

Oil Filter (Alt).info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

LUTY Integral Suppressor.info:
150 stud detection radius.

A shoddy garage-made integral suppressor for your garage-made SMG.
Barely makes your gun quieter but mildly improves weapon sway for slightly slower handling!

VKS Suppressor.info:
The iconic big suppressor for the VKS!
Excellent sound & radar masking while also improving bullet speed and penetration at the cost of some limb kill range and worse movement and handling.

Oil Filter.info:
10% muzzle velocity loss.
5 stud detection radius.

A fine quality homemade suppressor made out of a large oil filter. Superb sound masking, damage preservation and greater recoil control due to barrel weight at the cost of firerate and range.

Remove Suppressor.info: Remove the integral suppressor off of your firearm.

Osprey Suppressor.info:
35 stud detection radius.

A light multi-caliber Western suppressor manufactured by SilencerCo for pistol caliber weaponry. Provides better hipfire accuracy, range, and exceptional masking, however aim accuracy is not affected.

PBS-1 Suppressor.info:
80 stud detection radius.

A suppressor with compensated brake ports that has a significant improvement on horizontal camera recoil while also reducing rotational and translational recoil.
Reduces mobility and handling.
Less effective at sound masking and performance range.

PORQ Chop.info: Equip your Fix with the PorQ Chop, a heavy suppressor designed for the heavy caliber. Reduced velocity, deadly quiet. Improves CQC Torso ranges. Do not eat.
